reply_text:
I saved the draft mail to Hollis Mbeki and replied to Anselm in the DM; nothing has been sent.

- To: hmbeki@pemberline.com (internal, so Ruth's approval isn't needed).
- Subject: "Thornbury Cloth Co. – proposed 2027 per-seat rate"
- Body: the $2,101 per-seat rate, with a note that it came from Marcus Lindqvist and that Anselm approved sharing it.

No other approval was needed. Anselm is the CFO, so his approval is enough under the finance rule. The rate was also already in his message, so repeating it in the DM reply was allowed.
